title.en: The singer leaves (band keeps the logo)

summary.en: Half the comments say "not the real band." The other half buys the ticket anyway.
summary.zh: 评论区一半说「不是原班」。另一半照样买票。

body.en:
Ozzy gets fired; Sabbath keeps touring with Dio and later singers. Fans treat the logo like a sports franchise and the singer like a coach swap.

Sometimes the new voice is better for that album cycle. Sometimes it is karaoke with a famous riff library. Check the year on the shirt before you start the fight.
body.zh:
Ozzy 被炒；Sabbath 继续巡演，Dio 和其他主唱轮班。粉丝把 logo 当球队，把主唱当换教练。

有时新嗓子更适合那一轮专辑。有时就是拿经典 riff 库唱卡拉 OK。先看衣服上的年份，再开口吵架。

note.en: Ozzy out → Dio in: two peak catalogs, one argument forever.
note.zh: Ozzy 走 → Dio 来：两套巅峰目录，一辈子吵不完。

note.en: Roth vs Hagar camps never signed a peace treaty.
note.zh: Roth 派 vs Hagar 派从未签停战协议。
